findings.summary: pingTimer is declared but never assigned the setInterval id, so clearInterval(pingTimer) on close is a no-op.
findings.mechanism: `setInterval(function(){...},15000)` result is not stored (should be `pingTimer=setInterval(...)`); pingTimer stays undefined, so ws.onclose's `clearInterval(pingTimer)` clears nothing. Each reconnect via connect() creates a brand-new interval that is never cleared, leaking one extra ping loop per reconnect — exactly the concurrent-ping-loop bug the task asked to prevent.
